R33 R9 R11: a determination whose held check is voided reads void, naming the finding and what happened; each outcome reads undetermined with the recorded one beside it; it stays live and is never edited; a check still held is the control

R33 R7: a void determination stops being void only when a member supersedes it with one resting on findings that stand

R33: an accepted finding's source withdrawing its edition (or all) after the determination voids it; a newer edition voids it unless accepted here; a move before the determination, or taken back, does not; a moves read that fails is unreadable

R33: determinationVoided is the one answer to a void determination: R19's form with causes, its row C-113.37 naming this function; extra never replaces a fixed field; it writes nothing and never throws

R34 R2 R14: when the held check's edition is published holding the pinned version, every read answers the finding published with from_check beside it, nothing rewritten; published without that version it stays checked_held and reads void
